events.title: 리버풀 move back to the top of the First Division table by beating 에버턴 2–0 in the Merseyside derby . 31-year-old England midfielder 레이 윌킨스 returns to Britain after more than three years away when he signs for 레인저스 in a £250,000 move from 파리 FC St Germain .
Second Division promotion chasers 맨체스터 시티 beat struggling 허더즈필드 타운 10–1 at Maine Road . Three players - Paul Stewart , 데이비드 화이트 and Tony Adcock - score hat-tricks.
21-year-old 월솔 striker David Kelly scores a hat-trick on his debut for the Republic of Ireland in their 5–0 win over Israel in Dublin .

England seal European Championship qualification with a 4–1 win over Yugoslavia in Belgrade . A Gary McKay goal gives Scotland a 1–0 win in Bulgaria, a result that allows the Republic of Ireland, managed by former 1966 World Cup winner 잭 찰턴 , to qualify for their first major tournament.
리버풀 reject an offer from 바이에른 뮌헨 for Danish midfielder Jan Molby . 애스턴 빌라 boost their Second Division promotion quest with a £150,000 move for 크리스털 팰리스 midfielder Andy Gray .
Elton John agrees to sell 왓퍼드 to Robert Maxwell 's British Printing and Communication Corporation for £2million.
The takeover of 왓퍼드 falls through after the High Court vetoes it due to Robert Maxwell already being the owner of 더비 카운티.

리버풀 lead the First Division by five points from 아스널. 찰턴 애슬레틱, 노리치 시티 and 왓퍼드 continue to occupy the relegation places. 미들즈브러 and 브래드퍼드 시티 are level at the top of the Second Division on 43 points. 애스턴 빌라, 헐 시티 and 크리스털 팰리스 occupy the play-off places.
